key.name: bud-mac
key.description: Bluetooth MAC address in XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX format. Leave empty to auto-detect paired Galaxy Buds.

key.name: macrodroid-webhook
key.description: Optional MacroDroid webhook base URL triggered when disconnecting from Ubuntu to reconnect on Android.

key.name: lid-close-handoff
key.summary: Auto-Switch to Android on Laptop Lid Close
key.description: When enabled and Galaxy Buds are connected to Ubuntu, closing the laptop lid disconnects Bluetooth and triggers the MacroDroid webhook before Wi-Fi sleeps, then immediately releases the lid lock for normal system suspend.
